audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is absent from every field: Goes Where He Pleases resists the FIRST immobilizing effect that hits Mundo. Lilting Lullaby is your only hard CC and costs 150 seconds at rank 1.
audit.why: Cast into a live passive, the sleep does nothing but knock a chemical cannister onto the floor — which he then walks over to heal and to shorten the passive's own cooldown. A player who reads 'Level 6 makes ganks guaranteed' will burn a 150s ultimate for a free heal on the enemy. It must be stripped by someone else's CC first.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his Q 'Infected Cleaver' in three places. It is Infected Bonesaw.
audit.why: packet.enemyAbilities and the kit both give Infected Bonesaw (4s cooldown, 975 range, current-health damage plus slow).
audit.corrected: Corrected in whys[0], early and wants.foe[0]; the 975 range and Heart Zapper's 17s written in so the spacing advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 5 said Skill and row 6 said Lillia, against a mirror that is already committed the other way.
audit.why: drmundo__lillia.json commits Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Dr. Mundo with ratings 2/2/2/3/2/4/7 on his side. whys[3] 'your best lane window' and whys[6] 'he reclaims the matchup as the unkillable drain-tank' agree with it; only the stored sides did not.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 to Lillia, row 6 to Dr. Mundo, in matched pairs, with ratings 8/8/8/7/8/6/3 — the exact inverse of the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item was sold as an even 'Skill window'; it is your peak.
audit.why: Liandry's percent-HP burn plus a natively max-health DoT is exactly what punishes the largest health pool in the lane, and it is the last window before Maximum Dosage (120s, heals a percent of missing health) makes him unkillable at 2-3 items.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and whys[5] now state it as your window with the deadline attached; phases[6].why states his takeover.

edits.after: Mundo has only Infected Bonesaw poke and cannot land it on you at Q range — start the burn free.

edits.after: Heart Zapper stores damage and heals him — trade after the recast, not into it. It is 17s at rank 1.

edits.before: Mundo can't catch you and you can't be cleavered if you respect his Q range — last-hit with the tip of your Q and let the Dream Dust passive start ticking on him. At Levels 2-3 you layer the E slow into Q sweetspots and your move speed stacks until you're simply uncatchable, chipping his bar while he shrugs and farms. Don't greed into his Infected Cleaver (Q) throw — it's his only poke, so weave between minions and never give him a free percent-HP slice.

notes: The expensive gap here was not the chart: nothing on the page told the reader that Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect. Lilting Lullaby is Lillia's only hard CC and costs 150 seconds at rank 1, and cast into a live passive it converts into a heal for Mundo — he picks the dropped cannister up, restores health, and shortens the passive. The old phases[4] line promised 'ganks are now guaranteed', which is the exact opposite. Also corrected: his Q is Infected Bonesaw, not Infected Cleaver (three places), and it deals CURRENT-health damage, not percent max — the early text said percent-HP. Chart now matches drmundo__lillia.json exactly with inverse ratings. Only 10 recorded games at Emerald+ so the 80% is noise. report[8]'s 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' is right for once — Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage both heal.
